symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: An index of one axis of the array, between 1 and d.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, $i$ an axis index with $1\le i\le d$, and $q_i$ the number of positions along axis $i$, so $\boldsymbol q=(q_1,\dots,q_d)$.

symbols.name: positions along axis
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along axis i.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, $i$ an axis index with $1\le i\le d$, and $q_i$ the number of positions along axis $i$, so $\boldsymbol q=(q_1,\dots,q_d)$.

symbols.name: prime axis length
symbols.meaning: The source length of axis i, a prime length of the integer product.
symbols.quote: This bound needs power-of-two lengths, so it does not apply directly to the prime lengths $s_i$ of the integer product; the identity below supplies power-of-two transforms instead.

symbols.name: fractional bits
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional bits of the stored values.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional bits of the stored values, $\alpha$ an integer resampling parameter with $2\le\alpha<\sqrt p$, and $\delta$ a fixed constant with $0<\delta<1/8$ that sets the slack in the exponent $3/2+\delta$ of $p$ in the time bound.

symbols.name: resampling parameter
symbols.meaning: An integer resampling parameter with 2 <= alpha < sqrt p.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional bits of the stored values, $\alpha$ an integer resampling parameter with $2\le\alpha<\sqrt p$, and $\delta$ a fixed constant with $0<\delta<1/8$ that sets the slack in the exponent $3/2+\delta$ of $p$ in the time bound.

symbols.name: exponent slack
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant with 0 < delta < 1/8 that sets the slack in the exponent of p in the time bound.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional bits of the stored values, $\alpha$ an integer resampling parameter with $2\le\alpha<\sqrt p$, and $\delta$ a fixed constant with $0<\delta<1/8$ that sets the slack in the exponent $3/2+\delta$ of $p$ in the time bound.

symbols.name: source permutation
symbols.meaning: The index permutation of the source axis i.
symbols.quote: Let $P_{s_i}$ and $P_{t_i}$ be the index permutations of the source and padded axes, and $A_i$ and $B_{0,i}$ the linear input and output maps of axis $i$.

symbols.name: input map
symbols.meaning: The linear input map of axis i in the resampling identity.
symbols.quote: Let $P_{s_i}$ and $P_{t_i}$ be the index permutations of the source and padded axes, and $A_i$ and $B_{0,i}$ the linear input and output maps of axis $i$.

symbols.name: source axis lengths
symbols.meaning: The tuple of source axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $\boldsymbol s=(s_1,\dots,s_d)$ and $\boldsymbol t=(t_1,\dots,t_d)$ be the source and padded axis lengths, $\gamma=2d\alpha^2$ the total exponent of the scalar, and, with $R$ here not the scalar ring, $R=\bigotimes_iP_{s_i}$, $Q=\bigotimes_iP_{t_i}$, $\mathcal A=\bigotimes_iA_i$, $\mathcal B_0=\bigotimes_iB_{0,i}$:

relations.quote: The transform $F_{\boldsymbol q}$ is the tensor product of the one-dimensional normalized [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md) matrices $F_{q_i}$ of lengths $q_i$.
Each line transform is computed by the [Butterflies and the fast transform](butterfly.md) in $O(t_i\log t_i)$ operations.
